authorization.scope: Corrigir somente as fontes inválidas T01/T02/T03, preservando seus objetivos, leituras, inputs opacos, sinks e política terminal, com novo contrato e revalidação focal independente.

required_preservation: T01/T02/T03 retain the same reached counter/query operations, order, opaque carrier injection boundary and terminal expectations.
Only expression-result discard syntax necessary to prevent array/content joining may change.
T04/T05/T06, all expected results, diagnostics, sink policy, attempt budget and terminal product policy remain byte-identical by inheritance.
The R2 original remains immutable; the successor is a new artifact.
No compiler semantics, production source, normal API/entity/default, lifecycle contract or R4 observability requirement is changed by this authority.
unknown_policy: Any uncertainty that the replacement still executes an original read, preserves order, or reaches the intended terminal condition blocks the seal; it is not treated as success.
stop_conditions: A proposed source changes any value read or expected terminal outcome.
The focal reference still reports an unrelated language error.
Two focal iterations have the same failure cause.
A production compiler change appears necessary.

p1340_contract_correction.reads: L0, R2 contract/binding, R4 diagnosis and this authority; no candidate implementation or terminal adapter

p1340_terminal_oracle_r5.reads: sealed intent/contract inputs and vanilla; no candidate implementation or adapter
p1340_terminal_oracle_r5.writes: new p1340-terminal-harness-r5 and oracle receipts only
p1340_terminal_oracle_r5.forbidden: production code, expected outcome changes, verdict

p1311_review.reads: protected inputs, R5 contract/oracle and focal outputs

root.role: integration and candidate execution after seal
root.writes: adapter include switch only after seal, receipts and report
root.forbidden: editing independent R5 source/expectations or issuing own verdict

closure: This authority reopens only R2 input validity for T01/T02/T03. It does not reopen or require approval of the already-approved terminal policy.
